extensionDescription: Automatically unload inactive tabs on a timer, with precise website exceptions and normal or strict modes.
settingsIntro: Free memory from inactive tabs. Pages reload when you return.
automaticOnHelp: The timer starts when you leave a tab. Tabs in use stay loaded.
automaticPausedHelp: Paused. Background tabs get a fresh timer when resumed.
normalHelp: Keep pinned tabs, audio-playing tabs, and tabs marked not auto-discardable.
strictHelp: Request discarding at the timeout, including pinned and audio-playing tabs.
strictWarning: Playback may stop and unsaved work may be lost. Active tabs, website exceptions, and manually protected tabs stay protected.
timeoutHelp: Returning to a tab and leaving it starts a new timer.
rulesHelp: Mode and timeout apply after saving. Overdue tabs may unload on the next check. Sleep and browser scheduling can delay execution.
alwaysKeepHelp: Keep these websites in both modes.
themeHelp: Use your system's light or dark preference, or choose a theme. Changes apply immediately.
languageHelp: Follows Chrome's language. English is used when a translation is unavailable.
unsavedWarning: Discarding keeps the tab and URL, but cannot guarantee that unsaved page content survives.
allowIntro: Always keep these websites in both normal and strict modes.
websiteHelp: Enter a hostname or URL. All paths on that hostname are covered.
includeSubdomains: Also keep all subdomains of this hostname
noWebsitesHelp: Add documents, meetings, or work sites you want to keep loaded.
separateExceptions: These exceptions only apply to this extension, separately from Chrome's Memory Saver exceptions.
tableCaption: Tab status and manual protection. Protection lasts until the browser restarts.
unsupportedProtection: This page does not support manual protection.
noMatchingTabs: No matching tabs. Try a different search or filter.
pausedCheckHelp: Automatic discarding is paused. Resume it to check again.
tabProtectionHelp: Tab protection lasts until the browser restarts. Only tabs in this Chrome profile are shown.
activityIntro: Discard, restore, and failure events from this browser session.
noActivityHelp: Discarded, restored, and failed events will appear here.
activityRetention: Stored only on this device. Cleared when Chrome restarts or the extension is reloaded or updated.
eventRestored: Tab returned to use or reloaded
lastCheckFailed: The last check did not finish: $1. Try Check now in Tabs.
noticeResumed: Resumed. Background tabs get a new timer.
busy: Another action is still running. Please wait.
currentUnsupported: Browser or extension page; timeout discarding does not apply
inheritedProtection: Protected by $1 and its subdomains rule.
unsupportedActions: Tab and website protection are unavailable for this page.
errorInvalidHost: Enter a valid hostname, such as example.com. Use the option below for subdomains.
errorUnrecognizedHost: Cannot recognize this website. Check the hostname.
errorUnsafeDomain: This hostname cannot include subdomains. Public suffixes, IP addresses, and localhost only support exact rules.
errorInvalidTimeout: Enter a valid whole number of at least 1 minute.
errorInvalidTab: Invalid tab action. Refresh the list.
errorTabClosed: This tab was closed. Refresh the list.
errorTabMissing: Cannot find this tab. Refresh the list.
errorRuleMissing: This rule changed or was removed. Refresh and try again.
errorUnsupportedMessage: This action is unsupported. Reload the extension.
errorDiscardUnconfirmed: Chrome did not confirm discarding. A retry is scheduled.
errorExtensionRequired: Load this extension in Chrome before opening settings.
errorBridgeUnavailable: Cannot reach the background service. Reconnect to try again.
errorUnexpected: The action failed. Please try again.
staleData: Showing data from $1. Reconnect to make changes.
connectionNoData: Status is not available yet. Reconnect to try again.
